rounds: I have bought something just because I liked the advert.
Funny adverts work better than emotional ones.
A famous face in an advert makes me trust the product less.
Big billboards make Berlin look worse.
I would rather see a clever advert than a beautiful one.
Christmas adverts are the best adverts of the whole year.
Advertising on buses and trains should be banned.
I would happily work on an advert for a product I don't like.
